record.label: Additive Q24 pair-series tail extension
record.summary: Adjudicated at design stage by exact target-free measurement, with no data-bearing launch. The additive t=25..30 pair-series tail is cost-admissible (live added FLOPs 36,370,219,020 against the 67,331,117,831 headroom; synthetic billing 35,948,494,848 within 1.2%) and numerically stable on all eight probe rows including hard rows 201 and 643 and repaired tail 55 - unlike the closed full-Q32 rebuild - but it is effect-capped: the tail changes the reported means by a median 1.6e-5 of the final error scale (max final-layer delta RMS 1.2566e-8 versus population error RMS 3.0193e-4), bounding any aligned MSE effect near 8e-5 of MSE. The truncated Mehler tail is not where the host error lives; the S receipt's t=24 born-error correlation was co-location through bond strength, not causation. The quartic-star birth marker (+0.335) survives and points at the Edgeworth weight expansion order, whose pair weights stop at 1 + L3 + L4 + L3^2/2.
record.terminal_criterion: Closed measured at design: the effect-size conjunct failed by four orders of magnitude under exact target-free measurement; no retune and no scope variant. The sole licensed successor is the Edgeworth-order extension design probe P2R0F2U under the same measure-first protocol.
